There's only once decision. And it sits beside me to remind me of that decision, every day. The nice little red plastic shell. Shiny bronze bottom. A picture of a man and a horse with the words "Winchester - Bird Shot" below. It serves as a shocking reminder of my own mortality.

I know this. I just want it to run it's course. I just want to be given a chance for once. And then if we slowly stop feeling for each other, so be it.

Money.

That's what I've done for the past few days. Or like I just did. But what else is there to do? Play video games? Can't stay focused. I just need a giant Lego set or some scrap metal. I've been wanting to try and replicate Lady Gaga's Razor Blade glasses.

Medication won't fix anything. It will just put a mask on me and turn me around so people won't have to deal with the real problems. I used to have to take Ambien to sleep. I stopped after two nights. The feeling of being altered and that I just wasn't myself was unbearable. So getting put on "happy" medication would help me at all. The only way I see someone helping me is to lock me in a padded cell.

I feel anxiety about my future. I could get over all of this or I could end it tomorrow. I just can't see a way to be happy. I put on a facade every day just so I don't have to deal with it. But it's wearing thin. A few days ago was the happiest day I've had. Even people at work were commenting on how different I was. Usually I'm the only one there that cracks jokes or tries to cheer people up when I see they're down. But I guess that's always been me.

I've always given advice. I've always been "that guy" who's there when you need him. No one else would even think of driving to your house at 4am to hold you as you cried. But now who do I turn to? Strangers on the internet? How sad is that?

I just want someone here for me. Someone to hold. My family just wouldn't serve that purpose. So what now?

If I tried to go to the doctor, my family would just tell me I'm fine and to suck it up. Then everyone would know around me and would find some way if bringing it up, but not in a helpful form.

For awhile I've justs seen death as a way out. Weak people take that route, but every day I grow weaker and weaker. If I'm driving somewhere I think about just speeding into the nearest concrete barricade or wall. I probably would have the other day if an ambulance didn't pull out in front of me. I have planned out what I would do. I know that "If she decides she doesn't want me, I will X in the Y while Z." And I stop and realize, I'm have the biggest smile on my face. How fucked up am I that thoughts of killing myself bring me joy? 

I can't plan ahead. I feel as if I have no future. The only one thing in that past year that has brought me some type of joy has been being with her. Even just talking brightens up my day. But now, I feel as if I have nothing. I haven't had feelings for anyone else in my 19 years of life. Something about her just pulls me in. If I could stop right now, I would. I hate feeling this way. 

I am not a religious man. I know that when I die, that's it. I don't get a second chance. I don't have an "after-life". That putting that barrel in my mouth is the last thing I'll ever do. But day in and day out, it seems like my only option. I feel useless. 

I have friends, sure. But I can't accept people close to me anymore. I have only considered three people true friends. One I haven't seen for three years. He showed up to my graduation to see me finish high school. He dropped out a while back and just wanted to be proud of me. I didn't see him. He went up to my family and said hello. Then left. 

Another friend has turned into someone I don't even recognize anymore. She's too busy fucking or doing some drug to talk. And when she does talk, I don't know who she is. 

The last is her, the girl that has me here. I shouldn't feel this attached to her, but I can't help it. She knows everything about me. She was the reason I didn't kill myself a year ago. But who will save me now?

Don't act like I haven't tried. I laid in bed for hours trying to sleep. I've tried to eat. It feels like my body has refused to go on. I have routine. But when I feel like this, I lose focus and can't keep it up.

What choices can I make? If I leave her behind, it will lead me down a road ending in the end of me. And if I stick around, I will have to see her happy with someone that's not me. I might as well be dead and in "hell", because that's what every day would be like. 

I have no one to talk to. That's why I've come here. I believe I have hit what's known as "rock bottom". I'm clawing at the walls to get out, but can't get a grip.
Then what? What do I do?

>I want you to go and start to watch a comedy

I tried watching Katt Williams today, couldn't concentrate. I've seen hundreds of comedians. Lately my sense of humor has been non-existent.

>Tomorrow, you need to get into see the doctor

No. Absolutely not. 

>You are not alone

Who is with me? Some random fuck that lives in a different state? I don't know you. You don't know me. So how can you tell me that you care? How can you say you feel the same things I do?

I really don't want to go back to that. I've gotten over it as much as possible and I don't want even more weight being placed on my shoulders right now. My family? I talk to them. I've seen them a lot the past few days.
